reason: Automatically supplements grep/glob searches in configured knowledge-base directories with QMD semantic search results and injects those results into the agent context.

summaries.zh: 在知识库目录执行 grep 或 glob 搜索时，自动调用配置的 QMD 服务补充语义检索结果并注入后续模型上下文。
summaries.en: Automatically supplements grep or glob searches in configured knowledge-base directories with semantic results from a QMD service and adds them to the agent's next-step context.

capabilities: Detects grep and glob searches in configured knowledge-base paths
Queries a configured QMD MCP service for semantic search results
Injects supplemental search results into the agent's next-step context
Deduplicates repeated searches within an agent session
